title: Types Of Minerals Metallic Minerals Non Metallic Mineral
definition: Minerals are naturally occurring, inorganic, homogeneous solid substances with a definite chemical composition and crystalline structure, broadly classified into metallic and non-metallic categories based on physical and chemical properties.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for UPSC CSE Prelims (mineral belts, distribution, properties) and Mains GS-1 (economic geography) & GS-3 (resource security, mining policy, critical minerals).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Types Of Minerals Metallic Minerals Non Metallic Mineral.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic geology, rock types (igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic), and plate tectonics.
